description: Change the status of a Sentry issue — resolve it, mark it unresolved, ignore it, or set a resolution in the next release. Optionally attach a comment.

comment.description: Optional comment to add to the issue activity feed along with the status change

status.description: New status. 'resolved' closes the issue; 'unresolved' reopens it; 'ignored' suppresses it; 'resolvedInNextRelease' auto-resolves on next deploy.

name: update_issue_status
